LanguageData.BOR_Aegis.label: aegis
LanguageData.BOR_Aegis.description:
A cheap Preventative sold in bulk by the Kwazaari. The drug renders those who ingest it immune to malaria, sleeping sickness, plague, influenza, and parasitic infections. Must be taken every eight days in order to continue its effects.
This drug does not cure existing infections - but is capable of preventing any and all that have yet to take root, even those not yet discovered.
